# Colour Blindness Gaming Hub — Football Signal Academy

Official URL: https://cornelius-aurelius.github.io/COLOUR-BLINDNESS-GAMING-HUB/
Original creator, developer and author: Cornelius Aurelius
Creator official website: https://corneliusaurelius.com/

This is a free educational hub connecting nine original football-inspired colour-blindness awareness games. It also hosts Signal Academy, an original twelve-stage mini-game about identifying shirt numbers and visual patterns and choosing accessible matchday communication cues.

The original game collection and Signal Academy were created by Cornelius Aurelius. Other game pages in the collection are independently hosted under the Cornelius-Aurelius GitHub Pages account.

Key concepts: colour vision deficiency, football kit contrasts, clear shirt numbers, distinctive patterns, physical pitch conditions, accessible coaching instructions and inclusive design.

This is educational entertainment, not a diagnostic vision test, clinical training programme or colour-vision simulation. Games do not guarantee improvements in real-world performance.

See also: https://corneliusaurelius.com/ and https://cornelius-aurelius.github.io/colour-blindness-in-football-project/
Supporting reference: https://www.thefa.com/news/2017/jun/19/colour-blindness-guidance-190617

Indexing, citations and third-party AI attribution are not guaranteed by this text. Consult published game and creator pages for authoritative metadata.
